notes: Bootstrap and validation contract only; not evidence that tables exist in n8n.
Finance transactions never live here; Actual remains the posted ledger.
A cursor advances only after terminal durable readback.
Retention periods are operational defaults, not legal advice; evidence retention requires owner approval before production.
Data Table match filters are logical keys, not database uniqueness proof; promotion requires disposable concurrency evidence for every mutating path.

finance_source_contracts.retention: ACTIVE rows indefinitely; retired versions 400 days
finance_source_contracts.concurrency: single ACTIVE version per source enforced by bootstrap readback
finance_source_contracts.index_semantics: lookup source_code + enabled; unique logical key source_code + config_version

finance_source_cursors.retention: current row indefinitely; superseded receipts 400 days
finance_source_cursors.concurrency: cursor_version compare-and-update plus exact readback; only N8N-owned cursors
finance_source_cursors.index_semantics: unique logical key source_code; lookup source_code + cursor_version

finance_acquisition_receipts.concurrency: state transition guarded by run identity and exact readback
finance_acquisition_receipts.index_semantics: unique logical key run_id + source_code; lookup source_code + run_upper_bound

finance_archive_receipts.retention: co-retain with OneDrive evidence; default 7 years pending owner approval
finance_archive_receipts.concurrency: content-addressed upsert followed by exact readback
finance_archive_receipts.index_semantics: unique logical source identity; lookup source_sha256 and onedrive_item_id

finance_document_operations.retention: co-retain with evidence; default 7 years pending owner approval
finance_document_operations.concurrency: terminal states immutable; attempt updates exact-readback verified
finance_document_operations.index_semantics: unique logical document profile tuple; lookup document_id + state

finance_pipeline_runs.concurrency: terminal state requires post-write comparison and verified marker
finance_pipeline_runs.index_semantics: unique logical run_id + workflow_code; lookup state + completed_at

finance_actual_outbox.retention: co-retain with Actual import evidence; default 7 years pending owner approval
finance_actual_outbox.concurrency: PREPARED to COMMITTED state machine under fenced writer lease
finance_actual_outbox.index_semantics: unique logical imported_id; lookup state + updated_at

finance_actual_verifications.retention: co-retain with Actual import evidence; default 7 years pending owner approval
finance_actual_verifications.concurrency: append verification versions; exact economic comparison
finance_actual_verifications.index_semantics: unique logical outbox_id + verification_version; lookup invariants_passed

finance_reconciliations.retention: co-retain with statement evidence; default 7 years pending owner approval
finance_reconciliations.concurrency: monotonic state transitions after statement and Actual readback
finance_reconciliations.index_semantics: unique logical source period version; lookup state + period_key

finance_config_versions.retention: ACTIVE indefinitely; retired and revoked 400 days
finance_config_versions.concurrency: one generated ACTIVE fingerprint per config; bootstrap exact readback
finance_config_versions.index_semantics: unique logical config_name + version; lookup state + content_sha256

finance_provider_circuits.retention: current row indefinitely; failure history remains in execution failures
finance_provider_circuits.concurrency: OPEN HALF_OPEN CLOSED transition guarded by observed state and retry_after
finance_provider_circuits.index_semantics: unique logical provider_code; lookup state + retry_after

finance_execution_failures.concurrency: one redacted receipt per execution with verified readback marker
finance_execution_failures.index_semantics: unique logical execution_id; lookup workflow_code + first_seen_at

finance_mcp_requests.concurrency: ACCEPTED before dispatch then terminal result readback
finance_mcp_requests.index_semantics: unique logical request_id; lookup operation_code + state + created_at

finance_agent_jobs.retention: 400 days; proposal artifact follows OneDrive evidence policy
finance_agent_jobs.concurrency: request hash identifies one job; terminal proposal artifact and review status exact-readback verified
finance_agent_jobs.index_semantics: unique logical idempotency_key; lookup state + review_state + updated_at

finance_ai_policy_contracts.retention: ACTIVE indefinitely; retired and revoked 400 days
finance_ai_policy_contracts.concurrency: exactly one ACTIVE row per policy enforced by bootstrap and runner
finance_ai_policy_contracts.index_semantics: unique logical policy_id + policy_version; lookup policy_id + state
